result.summary: Found 1 major issue: the bottom navigation's active state is inconsistent with the content currently displayed.

issues.description: Bottom navigation active state does not match the displayed page: Profile is highlighted in green as the active tab, while the Home icon and label are grey, even though the screen shows the Home food-delivery feed.
issues.suggestion: Highlight the Home tab in green and render Profile in the inactive grey style when the Home feed is displayed, or navigate to the Profile screen if Profile is selected.
